inputs.text: The IOC is turning exclusion into policy, barring transgender women and DSD athletes from the female category at the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics and future Games. Calling it fairness and safety doesn’t erase who pays the price: athletes already pushed to the margins, while the institution offers no supporting detail here for its justification. This is a powerful body deciding whose participation counts, and presenting a sweeping rule as neutral when its burden falls on trans and DSD people.
